component.name: ShelfRemote
component.summary: A remote-friendly Linux client for Audiobookshelf

description.p: ShelfRemote is a 10-foot, remote-navigable Linux client for Audiobookshelf. It streams audiobooks and podcasts with libmpv, keeps listening progress in sync with your server, and integrates with desktop media controls via MPRIS. It is an unofficial third-party client and is not affiliated with the Audiobookshelf project.
